name: Flamincome USDT Strategy donatable Convex NAV
summary: The USDT Strategy's balanceOfY(), which prices VaultYUSDT shares, adds Convex BaseRewardPool.balanceOf(Strategy) times the USDP/3CRV get_virtual_price() to its Aave USDT. Anyone can stakeFor the Strategy, and virtual price ignored USDP's depeg. The attacker deposited flash-loaned USDT, staked cheap USDP/3CRV LP for the Strategy to inflate NAV, and withdrew more USDT.
notes: The reset is Aragon vote 21's Agent call Strategy.setImpl(0xff20de3f), which routed the Strategy to the Convex/Aave implementation whose balanceOfY() the exploit inflated. The implementation is unverified; the formula comes from the exploit trace.

Loss is gross depletion of the Strategy's Aave/USDT backing (595,787.54 USDT) net of the 92,658.36 USDT withdrawal fee that went to Flamincome's own Agent. The 691,647.8 depegged usdp3CRV the attacker staked for the Strategy is a gain in another asset and is not subtracted (rule 14); the attacker's net profit was 345,902.67 USDT.

Depositor 0x3d920c35 later redeemed at the still-inflated NAV in 0x1533ae36. That was an ordinary withdrawAll by an existing depositor, so it is not campaign; the only stakeFor to the Strategy not made by Flamincome is the anchor.
